reader.requirement: At --std 85 one CLOSE statement must accept file-names of different organizations (sequential, relative, indexed) and access modes (sequential, random, dynamic), each with the phrase its own module allows (WITH LOCK for any; NO REWIND/REEL/UNIT for sequential only), and must close each file by its own organization's rules.

edition-consulted.switches: CLOSE WITH LOCK accepted at 85, refused at 2023 (removed); not the mixed-organization path

reader.edition-search: Read BindClose (per-file resolution, per-file phrase check, one BoundClose per file) and EmitClose (per-file FileClose): no EditionContext/CobolVersion/ConstructRegistry test on the mixing; grepped Validation/ for VisitClose/closeOption: VersionConformancePass#VisitCloseOption and FlagConformancePass#VisitCloseStatement (FIPS flag only).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf18_05 mixes relative sequential/random/dynamic with a sequential file; indexed files, WITH LOCK and NO REWIND inside a mixed list are not exercised

probes.printed: CLOSE-1 07 00 00 00 / OPEN-2 00 00 00 00 / RECS AAAA BBBB CCCC DDDD / CLOSE-2 00 00 00 00 / OPEN-3 00 38 00 38 / CLOSE-3 00 00
probes.expected: CLOSE IXS SQ WITH NO REWIND RLF IXD closes all four (SQ 07: NO REWIND on a non-reel medium); CLOSE RLF WITH LOCK IXD SQ IXS WITH LOCK locks only RLF and IXS, so their re-OPEN is 38 and the others 00

probes.printed: COBOL1693 CLOSE 'RLF' with the NO REWIND phrase; SQ REEL in the same statement not refused
probes.expected: a sequential-only phrase on the relative file refused; legal on the sequential file in the same CLOSE

probes.printed: --std 2023: COBOL0902 for each CLOSE WITH LOCK
probes.expected: WITH LOCK accepted at 85, removed at 2023

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.4.2.3 SR1  (4.2.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1

reader.notes: A multi-file CLOSE binds as a series of one-file closes, each with its own file's organization, so mixing is automatic and edition-agnostic. The only edition arm on the statement is WITH LOCK's removal at 2023, which 85 correctly keeps.
reader.at-2023: mixing accepted; WITH LOCK refused as removed

refuter.evidence: Grepped Validation/ for VisitClose*: VersionConformancePass#VisitCloseOption and FlagConformancePass#VisitCloseStatement, as the reader listed. cl1.cob (--std 85): CLOSE IXF RLF SQF (indexed dynamic, relative random never opened, sequential) with a USE per file -> 'USE RLF 42', 'CLOSE-1 00 42 00': the failed relative close does not stop the indexed and sequential closes (§1985 CLOSE GR 'as if a separate CLOSE statement had been written for each file-name-1', grep line 17719), and the re-OPEN gives 'REOPEN 00 00'; CLOSE SQF IXF WITH LOCK then OPEN INPUT IXF -> 'USE IXF 38', 'OPEN-LOCKED 38'. cl2.cob: CLOSE SQF REEL FOR REMOVAL IXF UNIT and CLOSE IXF WITH NO REWIND SQF UNIT FOR REMOVAL -> COBOL1693 only on IXF in each, the sequential file's phrase accepted in the same statement. cite.py: OK  §1985:VIII.4.2.3 SR1  (4.2.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1.
